extraction.name: Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme-Series (PASTIS)
extraction.description: The first open-access dataset for training and evaluating panoptic segmentation models on SITS, with over 2 billion annotated pixels covering over 4000 km2.
extraction.creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot, Loic Landrieu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: PASTIS is comprised of 2 433 sequences of multi-spectral images of shape 10x128x128. Each sequence contains between 38 and 61 observations. The 10 channels correspond to the non-atmospheric spectral bands of the Sentinel-2 satellite.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The time between acquisitions is uneven with a median of 5 days due to the automatic filtering of acquisitions with extensive cloud cover.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentinel-2 satellite and the French Land Parcel Identification System
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Atmospheric correction and re-sampling at a spatial resolution of 10 meters per pixel.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each pixel is associated with a semantic label from a nomenclature of 18 crop types plus a background class. Each non-background pixel also has a unique instance label corresponding to its parcel index. Annotations are taken from the French Land Parcel Identification System.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The accuracy of the crop annotations is estimated via in situ control to be over 98%, with a relative error in terms of surfaces under 0.3%.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: Two labels per non-background pixel (one semantic label and one instance label).
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Remote monitoring of agricultural parcels is necessary for fair allocation of agricultural subsidies and ensuring best crop rotation practices are respected. It also has applications in surveying urban development and deforestation.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is highly unbalanced, with a ratio of over 50 between the most and least common classes.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Close to 28% of images have at least partial cloud cover.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluating panoptic segmentation models on Satellite Image Time Series (SITS).

rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis.evidence: The French Payment Agency estimates the accuracy of the crop annotations via in situ control over 98% and the relative error in terms of surfaces under 0.3%.

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: remote monitoring of the surface and nature of agricultural parcels is necessary for a fair allocation of agricultural subsidies ( 50and22billion euros per year in Europe and in the US, respectively) and for ensuring that best crop rotation practices are respected. More generally, the automated analysis of SITS represents a significant interest for a wide range of applications, such as surveying urban development and deforestation.

rai:dataBiases.evidence: As is common in remote sensing applications, the dataset is highly unbalanced, with a ratio of over 50between the most and least common classes.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: We estimate that close to 28% of images have at least partial cloud cover.
